intent_summary: Acceptable ranges and maximum absolute or relative changes identify explicit criterion violations, including before calibration.

criteria.criterion: Values outside an inclusive acceptable range are violations, while values on the boundary are accepted.
criteria.notes: Boundary values 10 and 20 are accepted; 9 and 21 violate the declared range.

criteria.criterion: Absolute and relative changes must exceed their declared maximum to violate a rule.
criteria.notes: Parameterized tests distinguish equality to the threshold from strict exceedance for both change rules.

criteria.criterion: Relative-change checks require a nonzero previous value and do not bridge missing observations.
criteria.notes: Zero/missing predecessors suppress relative comparisons, and missing values reset comparison history.

criteria.criterion: Violations identify the exact declared rule and remain action-ineligible unless policy explicitly permits them.
criteria.notes: Violation records retain rule ID/kind/bounds; default eligibility is false and replay requires explicit permission.

verification_evidence: Primary Codex agent re-inspected declared implementation references and criterion evidence in the current session after the outcome-title and deliverable-lane refactor.
Executed and inspected CLI examples, time preparation, policy replay, open-day monitoring, and MCP conversion evidence drilldown; .capabilities/reviews/deliverable-lanes/manual-checks.json.
